summary: The door swing has one abrupt snap at the cut, and the dancer reveal is otherwise clean, though he reads small and shifts side to side.

faults.what: The cream door fills the right half of the frame with its knob visible at 55.43. One frame later at 55.46 it is a thin sliver and the pink door behind it is fully open. The door travels most of its arc in a single frame, so it reads as a jump rather than a swing.
faults.fix: Add one or two in-between frames of the door swing, or start the swing earlier so the speed ramps up. Alternatively, cut on the sliver frame.

faults.what: The upper panel edge on the cream door shows a dotted or broken outline. It looks like an aliasing or shading artifact on the panel border.
faults.fix: Thicken or smooth the panel trim, or hide the edge with motion blur.

faults.what: The dancer is small and sits off-centre in the first frames of the reveal. He drifts right and grows as the camera pushes in, so the reveal of 'there he is' lands softly.
faults.fix: Frame him centred at the reveal, or push in faster so he reads at once.
